description: Cross-jurisdiction ad-creative compliance scan (~30 rules). Pass an image URL, base64 image, or just a landing-page URL plus caption — the scanner extracts on-image text, evaluates prominence/contrast/dark patterns/disclosures, and returns a full audit.

caption.description: Optional caption text shown with the creative on social.

image_b64.description: Base64-encoded image bytes (or data: URL). Use this if the image is not publicly hosted.

image_url.description: HTTPS URL of the ad creative image (jpeg/png/gif/webp, <= 5 MB).

text.description: Optional text accompanying the ad creative (caption or alt copy).

url.description: Public URL of a landing page connected to the creative — fetched server-side.

name: run_ad_creative_check
